name: Nyírkáta (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nyírkáta (a crowned blue shield with a red lion holding a sword, with a helm, a bird crest and red, blue and yellow mantling) above the year 1835 in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nyírkáta arms with crown, helm, crest and mantling
